caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware crock or jar with two small loop handles, one on each side, near the top rim. The body of the crock is a beige or light tan color, with a slightly darker, reddish-brown color visible inside the opening, indicating the interior glaze. The exterior surface features a cobalt blue painted design of a bird with outstretched wings and a long, curved tail, surrounded by dots and flourishes on the front side. There is an embossed or impressed maker's mark above the bird design, with the text "REDWINGER & CAIRE" and another line partially visible but not entirely legible. The drawing appears on a plain, off-white background, and the object casts a soft shadow beneath it. The artist's signature, "N. Armater," is located near the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
